notes: Shifts run seven days a week, 10 a.m. to noon and 12:30 to 2:30 p.m. Not everyone who applies gets a spot.
name: Students as Garden Educators (SAGE)
what_you_do: Teen volunteers lead fun plant, nature and history activities for children and families in the Garden. You build public speaking and job skills.
who_can_apply: You must be ages 14 to 18. You must send a letter of recommendation.
duration: June to October. First year: at least 50 hours including training.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Feb 28 to Apr 26, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online in the spring window. Upload a letter of recommendation. Spots are few. If you have a question, send an email to SageServiceProgram@mobot.org.
